violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. - Observed: a chemical mixing dispenser is connecting down stream from a mop sink equipped with an atmospheric vacuum breaker through an unapproved splitter.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. - Corrective actions: the establishment will re-install the approved splitter (hydro systems # 1951). FREDDIE MAC PHASE III (Inspection Date: 10/12/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. - OBSERVED: coffee shop hand sink hot water temperature was 94f.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: service engineer is repairing the hand sink. FREDDIE MAC PHASE III (Inspection Date: 04/17/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: - OBSERVED: (1) vegetable ratatouille (47f), egg potato spinach Gouda buritto (47f) and yogurt (49f) were stored in 2-door cooler (cs-2) overnight; (2) beef Philly cheesesteak provolone white wrap (47f) and fat free milk carton (47f) were stored in Eats2go cooler (item 45) overnight.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the food items.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: - OBSERVED: ambient temperature of 2-door cooler (cs-2) was 50f.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM placed a work order immediately.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. A FOOD EMPLOYEE FAILED TO WASH HANDS AND CHANGE GLOVES AFTER CRACKING EGGS AND BEFORE COOKING.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. CFM EDUCATED THE FOOD EMPLOYEE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SLICED TOMATO (44F) WAS STORED IN BEVERAGE-AIR 2-DOOR COOLER (HL-4) OVERNIGHT; YOGURT (48F) AND LOW FAT CHOCOLATE MILK CARTON (44F) WERE STORED IN EATS 2 GO COOLER OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEMS.
